purpose: Qualify a direct non-Lagrange fixed-common-level theorem instead of transferring the unreduced WP6-FI1-v1 conclusion by implication.
goal: Audit and qualify the Maciejewski-Przybylska-Combot rational nonintegrability theorem for the planar positive-mass three-body problem on every common level M_(h,c) with (h,c)!=(0,0), using Euler-Moulton homographic witnesses.
evidence_boundary: A PASS qualifies a pinned published theorem plus a project-owned exact audit of its common-level branch partition, Euler-Moulton spectral parameter, Kepler energy-angular-momentum relation, and representative normal-variational coefficients. It does not independently reproduce the universal differential-Galois proofs in the source appendices, does not transfer WP6-FI1-v1 to one reduced leaf, and does not cover (h,c)=(0,0), spatial motion, non-rational regularity classes, or a regular SO(3) chart through collinearity.

wp6_l0.role: Qualified predecessor for the c=0, h!=0 branch.

wp6_fi1.role: Pins the global-unreduced one-integral theorem and its prohibited fixed-leaf transfer.

wp2_so3_leaf.role: Pins the regular noncollinear SO(3) chart boundary; the Euler-Moulton witness is not inserted into that chart.

model.system: Planar Newtonian three-body problem with finite positive masses after center-of-mass reduction and algebraic complexification of mutual distances.
model.common_level: M_(h,c)={(r,p,d):H=h,C=c} in the source algebraic phase model.
model.integrability_class: Restricted rational complete integrability in the precise source definition.
model.witness: Euler-Moulton collinear central configuration and its Kepler homographic phase curve.

branches.zero_momentum: c=0 and h!=0; inherited from qualified WP6-L0-v1.
branches.noncircular_nonzero_momentum: c!=0 and 2*h*c^2!=-mu^2; use the noncircular Kepler homographic solution and source Lemma 5.1.
branches.circular_relation: c!=0 and 2*h*c^2=-mu^2; the real circular orbit gives no obstruction, so use the declared complex homographic solution and source Lemma 5.3.

model.spectral_parameter: For n=3, the tangent variational equation contains one physical four-dimensional block with delta=lambda-1>0 by the Euler-Moulton/Conley spectrum.

theorem_obligations.R1: Verify the two source payloads and exact theorem/title text contracts.
theorem_obligations.R2: Verify every pinned predecessor lock and PASS record by content hash and qualification identity.
theorem_obligations.R3: Represent the direct common-level theorem without deriving it from WP6-FI1-v1.
theorem_obligations.R4: Partition every finite real pair (h,c)!=(0,0) into exactly one declared proof branch.
theorem_obligations.R5: Reproduce the exact Kepler relation 2*h*c^2=mu^2*(e^2-1) and branch invariant.
theorem_obligations.R6: Reproduce the exact equal-mass Euler-Moulton matrix spectrum {0,1,12/5} and delta=7/5.
theorem_obligations.R7: Audit the noncircular block discriminant Delta^2=4*e^4+4*e^2*(delta+1)*(delta+4)+(delta+1)*(3*delta+4)^2*(9*delta+1), including strict positivity for delta>0 and e>0.
theorem_obligations.R8: Audit the circular block discriminant Delta^2=9*delta^2+10*delta+1 and the requirement to replace the obstruction-free real circular orbit by the declared complex witness.
theorem_obligations.R9: Match representative generic normal-variational coefficients against a source-disjoint exact implementation.
theorem_obligations.R10: Reject the double-zero level, one-additional-integral transfer, spatial transfer, non-rational regularity claims, and global regular-chart claims.

independent_validation.production: A pure-Python exact Fraction implementation classifies levels, proves branch identities and positivity certificates, constructs the equal-mass Euler matrix, and evaluates a generic normal-variational coefficient sample.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint SymPy implementation derives the Kepler relation from the conic orbit, constructs and diagonalizes the equal-mass Euler matrix, and evaluates the same coefficient sample without production imports.

adversarial_controls: Reject c=0,h!=0 if the WP6-L0-v1 predecessor is missing or changed.
Reject the real circular orbit as the obstruction witness for the circular relation.
Reject delta<=0 as satisfying the strict Euler-Moulton spectral premise.
Reject a claim about absence of one additional reduced-leaf integral.
Reject a meromorphic or non-rational regularity conclusion.
Reject insertion of the collinear witness into the regular noncollinear SO(3) chart.
Reject a reference implementation importing production code.

decision_policy.PASS: Every source, predecessor, branch, exact identity, independent-reference, adversarial-control, proof-coverage, and frozen-scope gate passes.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any source or predecessor mismatch, uncovered nonzero common level, branch overlap, exact mismatch, escaped negative control, implementation coupling, or claim-boundary violation fails v1.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: For arbitrary finite positive masses and every finite real common level (H,C)=(h,c) with (h,c)!=(0,0), the pinned Maciejewski-Przybylska-Combot theorem, with the project-owned exact branch and benchmark audit, proves that the planar Newtonian three-body problem is not rationally integrable in the locked restricted-integrability sense. The proof uses Euler-Moulton homographic witnesses and is direct on each common level rather than transferred from WP6-FI1-v1.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_DOUBLE_ZERO_CLAIM: The same campaign proves nonintegrability on (H,C)=(0,0).
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_ONE_INTEGRAL_CLAIM: No one additional first integral exists on each common level.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SPATIAL_CLAIM: The spatial common-level problem is qualified.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_REGULARITY_CLAIM: The theorem excludes all meromorphic, smooth, analytic, or non-rational integrability notions.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_DOMAIN_CLAIM: Every open phase-space domain outside the Lagrange neighborhood is pointwise nonintegrable.

invalidation: Any changed theorem statement, source payload, predecessor, common-level definition, branch relation, benchmark, obligation, control, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1.
